beats.en: You need old newspapers, some fenugreek seeds called methi, and water. First tear the newspaper into small pieces and soak them in water with a few methi seeds overnight.

textbookBox.concept: We can colour paper with natural ingredients like turmeric, spinach, beetroot and henna. To compare fairly, we cut the pieces of paper to the same size and use the same quantity of each ingredient.
